title: Gaussian noise increment variance identity
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\rho,\sigma\in[-1,1]$. Then
\[\bigl(\sigma\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\bigr)^2+\bigl(\sqrt{1-\sigma^2}\bigr)^2=\bigl(\sqrt{1-(\rho\sigma)^2}\bigr)^2.\]
